title: Introducing: PTEs in Admin Center (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Introduction to PTEs in Admin Center

features.name: PTEs visible in Admin Center
features.description: PTEs are now surfaced and displayed in the Business Central admin center, allowing administrators to see what PTEs are installed on their environments.

features.name: Admin Center API for PTEs
features.description: The admin center API now enables automation across PTEs and allows querying of installed extensions.

features.name: App Filter Dropdown
features.description: A new dropdown filter in the admin center allows filtering to view global apps, PTEs, and dev extensions separately.

features.name: Uninstall Apps from Admin Center
features.description: Global apps can now be uninstalled directly from the admin center UI, with the ability to choose whether to keep application data.

features.name: Dependency Visibility on Uninstall
features.description: When uninstalling an app with dependencies, the admin center now displays which apps depend on it, allowing the administrator to see what else will be uninstalled.

features.name: Uninstall Requirements API Endpoint
features.description: A new uninstall requirements endpoint in the admin center API allows developers to query which apps would be uninstalled as a result of uninstalling an app with downstream dependencies.
caveats: Available from admin center API version 2.25

features.name: App Type Property in API
features.description: New properties on the app endpoint in the admin center API allow reading the app type of returned apps.
caveats: Available from admin center API version 2.25

quotes.text: starting this release wave we'll start surfacing the PTEs that are installed on your environments in the admin center and in the admin center
quotes.why_it_matters: This establishes that PTE visibility in the admin center is new in this release wave and available through both UI and API.

quotes.text: whereas before we would only show global apps, we can now also see PTEES and dev extensions
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the change - the admin center previously only displayed global apps and now extends visibility to PTEs and dev extensions.

quotes.text: for the apps that can be uninstalled, which is almost all of them with exceptions, just as base app, um you can now click
quotes.why_it_matters: Defines the scope of which apps can be uninstalled and establishes the limitation that base app is an exception.

quotes.text: if I'm uninstalling an app that has dependencies, I can now see those dependencies right in the admin center
quotes.why_it_matters: Key new capability for administrators - they can now see dependency chains before uninstalling, preventing accidental cascade uninstalls.

quotes.text: everything that I just demoed in the admin center will also be available in the admin center API from version 2.25
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes that all UI features are available programmatically and specifies the minimum API version required.
